passages.text: Every autumn, our family likes to take a trip to Aunt May's farm. We travel by train and carry our lunch in a blue bag. Aunt May meets us and shows us the fruit trees beside her house. We often have picnics on the grass there instead of eating inside. My brother spreads a cloth, and I put out the bread and apples. After lunch, we put every cup and bag away before helping Aunt May. The visit gives us time together and a change from our busy town life.

parallelText.en: Every autumn, our family likes to take a trip to Aunt May's farm.
parallelText.zh: 每年秋天，我们一家喜欢去梅阿姨的农场旅行。

parallelText.en: We travel by train and carry our lunch in a blue bag.
parallelText.zh: 我们坐火车去，用一个蓝色的包带午餐。

parallelText.en: Aunt May meets us and shows us the fruit trees beside her house.
parallelText.zh: 梅阿姨迎接我们，带我们看她家旁边的果树。

parallelText.en: We often have picnics on the grass there instead of eating inside.
parallelText.zh: 我们常在那里草地上野餐，而不在室内用餐。

parallelText.en: My brother spreads a cloth, and I put out the bread and apples.
parallelText.zh: 哥哥／弟弟铺开一块布，我摆出面包和苹果。

parallelText.en: After lunch, we put every cup and bag away before helping Aunt May.
parallelText.zh: 午饭后，我们先收好每个杯子和袋子，再帮助梅阿姨。

parallelText.en: The visit gives us time together and a change from our busy town life.
parallelText.zh: 这次拜访让我们有时间相聚，也暂别忙碌的城镇生活。

passages.text: Our class visits the park after a night of rain. The grass is wet, and small drops of water shine on every leaf. Near the bridge, the water is deep, so our teacher chooses a path away from it. We stay on the path and watch the ducks from a wooden bench. Lily draws the birds while Ben counts the different colours he can see. Nobody needs to step on the grass to finish the activity. Back at school, we put our drawings together to show the park after rain.

parallelText.en: Our class visits the park after a night of rain.
parallelText.zh: 一夜雨后，我们班去公园。

parallelText.en: The grass is wet, and small drops of water shine on every leaf.
parallelText.zh: 草地湿了，每片叶子上都闪着小水滴。

parallelText.en: Near the bridge, the water is deep, so our teacher chooses a path away from it.
parallelText.zh: 桥边的水很深，所以老师选了一条远离水边的小路。

parallelText.en: We stay on the path and watch the ducks from a wooden bench.
parallelText.zh: 我们留在小路上，从木长椅上观察鸭子。

parallelText.en: Lily draws the birds while Ben counts the different colours he can see.
parallelText.zh: 莉莉画鸟，本则数自己看见的不同颜色。

parallelText.en: Nobody needs to step on the grass to finish the activity.
parallelText.zh: 没有人需要踏上草地就能完成活动。

parallelText.en: Back at school, we put our drawings together to show the park after rain.
parallelText.zh: 回校后，我们把画放在一起，展示雨后的公园。
